d: Since 1735, legend has it that a demonic creature, the Jersey Devil, has stalked the woods of one of America’s oldest states. Famous for its beaches, mosquitoes and Atlantic City casinos, New Jersey is also home to a monster.

st: Melonheads, Devil Monkey, Blue Albino Woman
d: Across America, grotesque mutant monsters like Melonheads, Devil Monkey, and the Blue Albino Woman seek revenge, terrorizing their victims with horrifying attacks.
For decades, citizen UFOlogists have coordinated alien information-sharing networks, subverting the classified intelligence of their governments.
A mysterious photograph with no plausible explanation. An aborted nuclear launch half a world away. And the continuing appearance of mysterious men in black.
Examining the possibility that UFOs may be from Earth.
Humanity has been plagued by international conflicts and epic powers since the dawn of time. Perhaps our greatest failure is constant strife and division.
Since the Jet Age, fighter pilots have been scrambled to intercept UFOs in our skies, but what happens when pilots are sent a Shoot Down Order and can't complete their mission?
Aliens have been trying to make contact with mankind for millennia. Now for the first time, one of those messages has been decoded and we will share that message with the world.

Jay Yaple persuades his wife that Enfield, CT, is the perfect place for them. After a series of unexplained events, Jay discovers the house has a dark history of mysterious deaths. Anyone who attempts to come to their aid is driven away by the demon.

The Fox family moves into a large old house in Lowell, Arkansas. Soon after, an angry ghost and demon begin to target the children, in their waking hours and in their dreams. The Fox family turns to a psychic, who confirms their worst nightmares.
Unsettling nightmares of a dark angry figure plague Cindy as she prepares to move her family to an old house in her rural hometown. Soon after they settle in, reality begins to mirror her nightmares.

Tiffany McKinnon, her boyfriend and his 7-year-old daughter move into a 200-year-old farmhouse Franklin, VA. Tiffany discovers that the spirit of a freed slave is haunting the home and is determined to make peace with him.

Victoria Dane was accidently overdosed before an emergency surgery and flat-lined for more than seven minutes. While recovering, she starts to notice unusual occurrences. She fears that she's opened a door to a paranormal world that can never be shut.
